messages:
maria: Heads-up — Pegasus signed the NDA this morning. Legal sent a 1-page redline summary, nothing blocking. @aj can you confirm lab ETA?
aj: Nice. Ops says 2 racks arriving week of May 10, provisional. Need rack serials + power/cooling specs to finalize.
pegasus-contact: (Pegasus) Thanks! We'll export rack inventory by EOD. Initial thermal envelope: nominal 2500W/rack, spikes up to 3200W under stress.
kevin: 2500W nominal — noted. What GPU family? If Ampere/Grace style, we should schedule extra cooling checks.
elaine: From our side we'll run baseline throughput + 99th latency tests. Plan: three workloads — gen50 (long context), chatburst (many short requests), embeddings sweep. Runner config: https://s3.redwood-internal/pegasus/eap/runner-config.yaml
sanjay: Please also give NVMe perf and switch topology. We want to pre-bake RDMA tuning if available.
maria: Legal asked for blackbox telemetry (temps, fan, power, perf counters). Partner agreed conditionally — they want a list of metrics and retention policy. @aj please share the probe spec.
aj: Minimal probe we'll collect (agreed with partner):
```
metrics: [gpu_temp_c, fan_rpm, p99_latency_ms, cpu_temp_c, gpu_util_pct, power_draw_w]
interval_sec: 5
retention_days: 30
```
kevin: Add per-node power_draw and a thermal-throttle alert at 85C. Also capture nvlink errors.
pegasus-contact: We can provide power-draw telemetry and nvlink counters. We need serial masking for any public reports (HIPAA-free).
maria: Acknowledged — public artifacts will have masked serials. Internal bench reports keep full traces for triage.
elaine: Ops scheduling note — do blackbox burn-in immediately after rack bring-up. Allocate 8h for burn-in + 12h for baseline automated runs.
sanjay: We'll want to run a quantized int8 sweep and an fp16 baseline. Can Pegasus drop two checkpoints (fp16 + int8 seed) to s3? Also need a small eval set for regressions.
pegasus-contact: Will upload checkpoints + eval set + jumpbox creds to s3 by tomorrow morning (s3://pegasus-eap/ckpts). We'll also include a CSV of node IDs with masked serial mapping.
maria: Good. Ops: who owns the initial bench report writeup? I can draft the public summary; engineering should fill perf appendix.
kevin: Engineering can own perf appendix — @sanjay will own the numbers and perf notes.
sanjay: Yep, I'll draft the perf appendix and include kernel/compilation notes.
maria: Marketing wants a joint blog ~4 weeks after SLO validation. Any objections?
kevin: Fine as long as we lock regressions and thermal profile. :thumbsup:
maria: I'll post a quick risk checklist here by EOD and schedule a weekly sync with Pegasus (Tuesdays).
partner-bot: Pegasus NDA signed by legal@pegasus.com at 2026-03-20T14:03:12Z
maria: Thanks — filing the runway doc: https://drive.redwood/pegasus/onboarding-runway. If anyone needs edit access ping me.
pegasus-contact: Appreciate the coordination. We'll add a contact p2p (ops@pegasus.com) in the s3 upload.
maria: Perfect. Next actions: aj to confirm rack serials + cooling spec by EOD, pegasus-contact to upload artifacts by tomorrow, sanjay to prepare perf sweep plan.
aj: On it, will update thread when inventory is posted.
kevin: I'll prep the thermal alert thresholds config and share a snippet here.
maria: thanks all — closing this thread and will create a follow-up calendar invite for the weekly sync.
